title: Daily claims and risk bullet log — Amina Yusuf
content:
Purpose: quick daily scratchpad for 1:1 prep, rapid claims I can make in syncs, and an accompanying single-line risk + mitigation for each claim. Goal is to be concise so manager syncs are focused and decisions are actionable.

TODAY (quick toplines):
- Claim: Hiring pipeline conversion for platform eng internships improved by ~12% week-over-week.
  Evidence: Source-stage->offer conversion data pulled from GH-PR-2287 notes; 4 offers extended, 3 accepted in last sprint.
  Risk: Acceptance rate could drop if offer comp recs not aligned to market.
  Mitigation: Run quick comp-check with recruiting team (10m ask), propose 2% bump option.

- Claim: New onboarding checklist reduced first-week enablement tickets by half for hires in Jan cohort.
  Evidence: 1st-week SRE tickets: Jan cohort n=6 vs Dec cohort n=12.
  Risk: sample size small; could be noise.
  Mitigation: Track for 2 more cohorts then propose checklist as default.

ONE-LINER ASKS (what I want from manager):
- Quick nod to pilot extended offer comp for 2 candidates (decision needed this week).
- Time to sync with Eng Hiring PM (15m) to align on interview rubric tweak.

60s 1:1 SCRIPT (practice):
- Opening claim (10s): "Hiring cadence is improving — +12% conversion, small signal that sourcing + rubric changes are working."
- Evidence (20s): "Flags: 4 offers, 3 acceptances; calendar-linked feedback from interviewers; reduced duplicate loop in take-home assignment."
- Risk (15s): "Market moves fast; comp mismatch could undo gains."
- Ask (15s): "Approve a small comp adjustment for two candidates and a 15m alignment with Eng Hiring PM."

EVIDENCE SNIPPETS (copy-ready lines):
- "Jan cohort first-week enablement tickets: 6 (vs Dec: 12) — onboarding checklist pilot correlated with fewer blockers."
- "Sourcing -> offer conversion: 18% -> 30% (sample n~40) in last 3 weeks; need to validate with next 2 weeks."

RISKS I MAY BE ASKED ABOUT (prep answers):
- Q: "Is the conversion uplift causal?"
  Prep: "Not yet definitive. We changed two variables (rubric + sourcing). Plan: stagger rollout of rubric change next week to isolate effect."
- Q: "Budget impact of comp change?"
  Prep: "Two hires = ~3–4% over baseline for this quarter; we can absorb within hiring cushion or shift backfill timeline by 2 weeks."

MEASURES TO TRACK (next updates):
- Offer acceptance rate (weekly) — goal: sustain >25% for 4 consecutive weeks.
- First-week enablement tickets per hire — target < 3.
- Time-to-fill for mid-senior ICs — monitor for any increase after rubric tweak.

MICRO EXPERIMENTS / NEXT STEPS (7 days):
- Run comp-check with recruiting (Ethan) — timeline: Tue morning.
- Stagger rubric rollout for two teams (platform eng, serving runtime) — start Wed.
- Add 'first-week blocker' quick survey to new hire checkin (2 questions) — owner: Mira; due Fri.

OPEN QUESTIONS (need to resolve by next sync):
- Do we formalize the onboarding checklist as default for all eng hires or continue pilot?
- If acceptance drops after comp unchanged, what's the threshold to auto-approve comp bump?

NOTES TO SELF (quick heuristics):
- Keep claims crisp: 1 claim per sync, 1 supporting datapoint, 1 mitigation.
- If manager asks for numbers, call out sample sizes immediately.
- When proposing comp changes, always include a short budget impact line.

ACTION ITEMS (tick when done):
- [ ] Confirm comp-check time with Ethan (Tue 9am)
- [ ] Draft staggered rollout plan for rubric (share by Wed EOD)
- [ ] Publish 2-question first-week survey (Mira)

QUICK NUMBERS (back-of-envelope):
- Current active reqs (owning): 8 (2 priority), 3 offers outstanding, projected hires this Q: 5–7.
- Hiring spend cushion available: ~$45k for Q1 (approx).

SNIPPET FOR ASYNC UPDATE (Slack/Thread):
- "Short update: onboarding checklist pilot looks promising (first-week blockers down ~50%); staggered rubric rollout this week to isolate effect. Need quick nod on comp adjustments for 2 near-offer candidates."

END-OF-DAY REFLECTION (template):
- What moved? 
- Which claim strengthened? 
- Biggest unknown now? 

(Use this doc as my morning/afternoon short-run notes. Keep it tight, cut long context in syncs and surface only the claim + evidence + ask.)
